To solve this problem, we can use the following formula:

$$
\text{part}=\text{percentage}\times \text{whole}
$$

In our case, the whole is $25,$ and the percentage is $0.6%.$ 

**Method 1**

First, we convert the percentage to a decimal:

$$
0.6%=0.6÷100=0.006
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =0.6%\times 25 \\  & =0.006\times 25 \\  & =0.15\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $0.6%$ of $25$ is $0.15.$ 

**Method 2**

First, we convert the percentage to a fraction:

$$
0.6%=\frac{0.6}{100}=\frac{0.6\times 10}{100\times 10}=\frac{6}{1,000}
$$

Applying our formula, we have:

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{part} & =\text{percentage}\times \text{whole} \\  & =0.6%\times 25 \\  & =\frac{6}{1,000}\times 25 \\  & =\frac{150}{1,000} \\  & =0.15\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, $0.6%$ of $25$ is $0.15.$
